_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. The right column's tool tabs (Timers, Messages, Props, Macros, Stage, Audio, VoxLive) and what they draw: cards, menus, fields, empty states, timer kinds, macro steps, stage layout items and the stage screens' NEXT label (ДАЛІ, in capitals), and what saving these things says. Rows in capitals (PLAYING, CROSSFADE, the VoxLive note) are drawn as written. A count of seconds is written with «с» so the number needs no plural. Rows ending in .short are used where the usual words don't fit their room (the Props card's second line, the Stage tab's screen picker and its heading, the Audio level's Muted). Names the app gives and saves (a new timer, message, prop, macro, audio playlist, Quick message) are plain Ukrainian names.
